# CannaBusTeD — My Fake Life

> My Fake Life is a 23-track double album and immersive online world by CannaBusTeD, a housebound blind songwriter from the North East of England. Songs, lyric book, artwork and hidden doors.

The site is a single album world: a landing page ("the door"), the full album experience with player, lyric book and artwork, and a listening hub linking to streaming platforms.

## Pages

- [Landing](/): The way in — the night-service door to My Fake Life.
- [Album](/album): The full My Fake Life experience — 23-track player, lyric book, artwork and stories.
- [Listen](/listen): Streaming and social links — Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook — plus the free return-ticket mailing list.

## Optional

- [Ted on Tour](https://myfakelove.cannabusted.com): A companion site from the same world.
- [My Fake Book](https://myfakebook.cannabusted.com): Two novellas set in the same town as the songs, free to read online.
